candidates.description: Smelt raw ore batch 1 in the primary furnace, turning it into ingot batch 1.
Smelt raw ore batch 2 in the second furnace, turning it into ingot batch 2.
Forge ingot batch 1 at the anvil into a finished ingot.

jev.instructions: Given the actions legal this round in a small crafting world, choose the one that advances the raw-ore-to-finished-ingot process, preferring an action that has not already fired over one that has.
